item.title: Bitcoin-Backed Bonds Facing Stress Test After Bitcoin Selloff, S&P Says
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin-Backed Bonds Facing Stress Test After Bitcoin Selloff, S&P Says Wall Street’s first public bitcoin-backed bond, issued by Ledn and rated by S&P, is facing stress after a 27% bitcoin drop forced liquidations. This post Bitcoin-Backed Bonds Facing Stress Test After Bitcoin Selloff, S&P Says first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
